title: Tallado Qullunakan Profetapawa
intro: Nayra Arabia markan qʼañu wasar pampanakanjja, mä jaqew uñstäna, jupanakajj wali uñtʼat jaqenak taypinwa uñstäna. Utanakapajj wali chʼamani qalat sartasïna, ukampis chuymanakapajj kʼullut lurat qollunakat sipansa jukʼamp chʼamapunïnwa. Mä divino yatiyirix mä sapa, milagro chimpumpiw purinitayna — ukampis jach’a jach’a tukuñamp jan yäqañampiw jank’ak ukat axsarkañ jan walt’awinakar puriyatayna. ¿Kawkïr jachʼa uywatatï markapajj irpañat sipansa tʼunjañ ajllkäna uk uñtʼasmati?
clues: Nayarojj mä yatiyiriw markajar khitanitäyäta, mä sapa Diosar yupaychapjjañapataki.
Markajajj wali muspharkañ qalanak taypinwa jakasipjjäna, qollunakanjja wali suma utanakaw lurapjjerïna.
Oracionajatjja, mä milagro lurir camellojj wali chʼamani qalat mistunïna, ukajj Taqe Chʼamani Diosan qhan señalapawa.
Nayax markajarux aka camello warmimp uma jaljapxam, jan kuna jan walt’ayapxamti sasaw sista.
Markajajj camello warmi contraw mä amtar puripjjäna, ukatsti chʼakhanakap chʼoqantapjjarakïna, ukhamat jupanakan tʼunjatäñapataki.
Mä ajjsarkañ uraq khathatiw markajarux purtʼäna, ukat jan kuns kamachtʼasaw utanakapan liwxatatäpxäna.

trial.label: ¿Kunas uka juiciojj qhanañchäna?
options: Mä milagroso camello warmin isquiotibiales sat chʼakhanakapa
Sawkasiñ taypin mä jachʼa arca luraña
trial.answer: Mä milagroso camello warmin isquiotibiales sat chʼakhanakapa

outcome.label: ¿Kunas jupanakan qhepat pasañapäna?
options: Mä jach’a uma jalsun umamp chhaqhata

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
